raw: Hello Hannah, come and take a seat. What would you like to talk about today?
I'm not really sure where to start. I think I'm just anxious all the time and it's got worse in September.
What happened in September?
I was made deputy head at my school. I've taught here for 11 years and I love it. And then they had asked me to step up and when our deputy...
That sounds like recognition of your work.
That's what everyone says but I keep thinking they picked the wrong person and that sooner or later someone will notice I have no idea what I'm doing.
What does it look like when the doctor arrives?
Mostly Sunday evenings my chest goes tight and I start rehearsing Monday's stuff meeting in my head.
What do you rehearse?
Every possible question someone might ask and what I would say and what they would think of me if I got it wrong.
Would you imagine they would think?
That time out of my depth, the day gave the job to a nice earful teacher who can't actually
Has anyone said anything that's just that?
No, that's the strange thing. Nobody has. It's all in my head.
It's still very real to you.
Very. Last week I rewrote the same email three governors four times.
What was the email about?
Change to the behavior policy. It was two paragraphs. I was afraid Mr. Hargraves, the chair of governors, would think that I was stupid.
How does he treat you?
He has been nothing but kind. He told me in September he was delighted. That makes it worse somehow because I feel like I'm lying to him.
Lying down in a bowl bot.
About being capable as if I'm pretending.
Pretending to be what?
Somebody who knows what she's doing. Most days I feel like a child wearing her mother's coat.
Oops, that's a video match. Who's called to that?
My mum's, I suppose. She was a headteacher for 20 years.
Tell me about that.
She was brilliant. Everyone in the village still stops me to say what a wonderful pet she was. She retired six years ago and they have named a library after her.
The client talks about family, work, sleep, anxiety and feelings.
The client says that she has a lot of work to do and that she is very busy.
Does she say that?
Never. She is very supportive on the surface. She says I've always worried too much and I should stop being silly.
How does it blend when she says that?
It makes me feel like I'm making a fuss so I don't tell her how bad it is.
What does she not know?
That I'm awake at 4 every morning. I fall asleep fine. Then I'm awake at 4 going through the to-do list.
Lesson de list.
Everything, timetable changes, the offset prep, a parent complained, a child I'm worried about. It goes round and round.
How long have you been waking like that?
Since about the second week of term I drink a lot of coffee to get through a day which I know doesn't help.
How many cups?
At 5 or 6 then I can't sit still in the afternoons.
What do you notice in your body during those afternoons?
My heart goes fast. My hands are a bit shaky. Last Thursday I had to leave a meeting to splash my face with water.

I don't think so, I said I was fetching a document.
But it sounds like a lot of effort to hide it.
It is, I am exhausted by the end of every day just from pretending.
Who knows how you're feeling?
My partner Ben knows a bit. He says I should just enjoy it.
How do you feel when he says that?
Guilty and a bit alone. He means well. He's an engineer. He thinks if something's a problem, you fix it.
The client becomes respectless.
No, I wish it were that simple.
The friends that go will talk to him.
Not anymore, not really. I used to eat lunch in the year for a critter with the others. Now I'm their line manager and it's all great.

Yes, I hadn't thought of it like that. I missed my class too.
What do you miss most?
The children mostly. The daily bit where a child gets something for the first time. No, my days are spreadsheets.
Do you want deeper emotions?
I thought I did. I said yes in the room because I couldn't say no to her. Then I went home and cried.
What were the tears about?
I think that I would never get to go back.
Would you want to go back?
I don't know. That sounds terrible, doesn't it? After everything's been so... everyone's been so supportive.
It sounds like an honest question.
Nobody has asked me dad, they just say well done.
What was the last time you felt properly relaxed?
These summer holidays we went walking in the lakes and I didn't think about school once for 10 days.
What was different there?
Nobody expected anything of me. I was just walking. Ben carried the sandwiches.

The week before term I was a wreck again. I couldn't eat on the Sunday.
Is there anything you already tried to tell?
I sort of write down what went well each evening, small things, a chill laugh thing, a good email.
How did that go?
It held for about two weeks and then I stopped because I felt silly.

Noticing what went well is not the same as bragging.
Probably not. It just felt that way.
That sounds worth coming back to. Have you thought about whether there is something particular you'd like from our work?
I would like to do the job without feeling like a fraud.
What does that look like on a Tuesday?
Walking into a meeting and not rehearsing it first, sending an email once.
And on Sunday...
Being able to sit on the sofa in the evening without my stomach in knots.
Those are clear goals. How do you feel now saying them out loud?
Later, a bit tearful actually.
That's where I take a moment.
Sorry, I didn't expect that.
There is nothing to apologize for. What's coming up?
That's the first time I have told anyone how bad it is. Not even Ben knows how about it for a young.
What would it be like to tell him?
Scary. He would probably be hurt that I didn't say sooner.
Would it be a reason to keep it to yourself?
I suppose not. I might try this week.
What would help you do that?
If I choose a quiet moment, not on a Sunday evening, then I'm too wound up.
Saturday morning, perhaps.
Yeah, over breakfast he is always in a good mood then.
And one more small thing. Would you try the evening notebook again just for a week? Even one line.
I could, I will put it by the kettle so I don't forget.
Alright, we're nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
One lady I nearly cancelled this morning. I'm glad I didn't.
Same time next week.
Yes please, thank you.
